title: cs-daily-scratchpad-samira-2026-03-15
content:
Daily scratchpad - QBR / renewals / follow-ups (stream-of-consciousness, TODOs, quick links)

Notes to self:
- Morning run-through before 9am standup: priority accounts (see list below).
- Keep outreach concise: 2 bullets max (impact + ask).
- Add small metric to QBR slides: 90-day avg latency improvement after Redwood Optimize pilot for Hawthorne (they like numbers).

Priority accounts (renewal windows / action):
1) Hawthorne Media (Annual renewal 2026-04-20)
   - Owner: Jordan Bell (AM)
   - Health: green -> low support, adoption growing in recommendations flow
   - Action: schedule executive QBR week of 2026-04-06; confirm invitees (CTO + Engineering lead). Draft agenda items: usage trends, cost optimization opportunities, 90-day performance gains, next-gen private deployment readiness.
   - Outreach draft: "Quick sync to prepare for annual renewal - 20min to review usage, savings, and roadmap alignment?"
   - Linked PRs/notes: CONFLUENCE QBR template, perf dashboards (console>Hawthorne>model-routes)

2) Lumenix Health (Monthly commitment; upcoming pilot renewal 2026-03-31)
   - Owner: Priya Nair
   - Health: yellow -> a spike in latency last week after 3/9 release; SRE investigating.
   - Action: Confirm RCA ETA from platform-engineering; hold a support bridge if RCA delayed >48h. Prep SLA credit language in case of >1% error window during pilot.

3) Atlas Retail (Dedicated capacity customer; expansion ask)
   - Renewal not due, but upsell opportunity: add Dedicated burst pool for holiday traffic.
   - Action: Prep cost modeling (per-token vs dedicated seat) and sample throughput numbers - ask infra for last 4 weeks peak qps.

Support follow-ups (quick hits):
- CS-4127 (Hawthorne telemetry gap): pinged engineering on 3/14; need ETA on ingestion fix. If >3 business days, escalate to SRE lead.
- CS-4199 (Lumenix latency spike): assigned to platform on 3/13; scheduled deep-dive 3/16 11am PT. Make sure customer rep invited.
- CS-4210 (Atlas rate-limiting on embed API): suggested client-side batching; draft snippet to send to dev contact (Samir).

QBR prep checklist (for exec + technical slides):
- 1 slide: One-line account summary + renewal status
- 1 slide: Usage & cost trend (last 90 days) - show token volume + effective cost/unit
- 1 slide: Performance highlights (latency P50/P95) + any regressions and mitigations
- 1 slide: Success stories / wins (e.g., 25% perf gain with quantization profile)
- 1 slide: Roadmap & asks (dedicated capacity, private deployment timelines)
- Appendix: relevant logs, incident timeline, runbook links

Outreach templates (short):
- QBR ask: "Hi <Name>, are you available for a 30-min QBR the week of <date>? We’ll cover usage, ROI, and recommended next steps for cost/performance. Thanks - Samira (Redwood)"
- Renewal nudge: "Friendly reminder: your renewal is scheduled for <date>. I’d love to ensure we align on goals and any adjustments needed ahead of time. Could we set a quick call?"

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who owns the Hawthorne exec invite list? Jordan said CTO and Eng lead but confirm PM+Procurement presence.
- Get Atlas peak qps from infra (contact: m.chen@redwood.com)
- Confirm whether Lumenix incident will require SLA credit (legal/finance input)
- Draft follow-up code snippet for Atlas embed batching by EOD 3/16

Meeting notes (3/14):
- Quick sync with Jordan (Hawthorne): they want clearer cost breakdown per model route; asked for a per-route dashboard in Console. Action: escalate to observability team to expose per-route breakdown.
- Lumenix status call: platform team already rolled back last deploy; observing metrics. Agreed to 11am deep-dive 3/16.

Quick reminders:
- Upload QBR draft to Confluence under CS/QBR_drafts/Hawthorne by 3/22.
- Put calendar hold for executive QBR options (weeks: 2026-04-06 or 2026-04-13)
- Update renewal tracker spreadsheet after each outreach (link: CONFLUENCE:CS/renewal-tracker)

Notes-to-self (informal):
- If time, add 2 bullet customer-centric win notes to QBR (tangible outcomes > features).
- Keep templates lean - execs delete slides, not content.
- Check Slack #cs-east for any mentions of Hawthorne or Atlas errors before calls.

End of scratchpad.

-- Samira
